title: Transcranial Doppler
what: The doctor uses ultrasound through the skull to see how blood flows in the brain's vessels. It is safe and painless.
why: For dizziness, after a stroke, with narrowed neck arteries, frequent headaches, or some blood disorders.
duration: usually 20 to 40 minutes; the report is ready right away
tell_doctor: What bothers you and for how long
If you had a stroke, head injury, or surgery
Past tests of the neck and head vessels

prepare.title: Prep
prepare.text: Usually none. You can eat and drink.

prepare.title: Morning
prepare.text: Better to skip extra coffee, energy drinks, and smoking. They affect blood flow.

prepare.title: Hair
prepare.text: No hair products or styling. Gel goes on the temple and the back of the head.

steps: Gel is put on your temple
The doctor presses the probe to your temple and finds the vessels
Then the back of the head is checked. You are asked to tilt your head forward
Sometimes you are asked to hold your breath or breathe fast
feel: Light pressure on the temple and the back of the head
Breathing fast can make you a little dizzy. It passes
after: You can go back to your usual day right away
The report is usually ready right away
Go over the results with a neurologist

faq.q: Can ultrasound go through the skull?
faq.a: Yes, through thin spots: the temple, the back of the head, and the eye socket. In some people the bone is thicker, and the view is not as clear.

faq.q: Is it dangerous for the brain?
faq.a: No. Ultrasound uses no radiation and does no harm.

reminders.text: Transcranial Doppler tomorrow. In the morning, skip extra coffee and smoking. No hair styling.
